policy.content: No cross-study photograph, generic laboratory equipment or privately identifiable medical image may stand in for experimental data. Manuscript images must be the specifically catalogued witness, not a similar-looking Arabic page.
policy.license: Each media item must have a verified page/DOI/repository ID and a reuse license or owner release. Pending rights means no embedding.
policy.motion: Physical motion describes the actual explanatory mechanism and is explicitly conceptual; experimental numerical traces are animated only from verified data.
policy.review: Every scene requires approval of its fact, asset identity, license, legibility and pronunciation before default public replacement.
policy.fallback: No same-source image available -> original authored labelled geometry or kinetic typography; never random other-study photos.
